desc: Read N, K, build adjacency list for tree of size NK.
Handle K=1: immediately print "Yes" and exit.
Compute parent array and post-order traversal using iterative DFS from root 1.
Initialize up[] array (size NK+1) and closed path counter.
Process nodes in reverse post-order: collect child remainders, sort, greedily pair smallest+largest, close paths when sum==K, propagate remainders.
After processing root, verify closed == N and up[root] == 0; print "Yes" or "No".
Test on edge cases (N=1, large K, star graph, path graph).
